experiences.name: Angkor Wat Sunrise Temple Tour
experiences.description: Explore the magnificent Angkor Wat complex at sunrise, witnessing the iconic reflection of the temple spires in the surrounding moat. Hire a local tuk-tuk driver to visit Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple with its enigmatic stone faces, and Ta Prohm, the jungle-engulfed temple made famous by Tomb Raider. A one-day pass grants access to the entire Angkor Archaeological Park.

experiences.name: Phnom Penh Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda Visit
experiences.description: Tour the stunning Royal Palace complex and the adjacent Silver Pagoda, home to a floor made of 5,000 silver tiles and a life-sized gold Buddha adorned with diamonds. Explore the National Museum of Cambodia nearby to view the world's finest collection of Khmer art and sculpture, gaining deep insight into Cambodia's royal history and cultural heritage.

experiences.name: Koh Rong Samloem Beach Escape
experiences.description: Take a ferry to the pristine island of Koh Rong Samloem and spend the day on Saracen Bay, one of Southeast Asia's most beautiful and unspoiled beaches. Enjoy crystal-clear turquoise waters, white sand, and excellent snorkeling among vibrant coral reefs. At night, witness the magical bioluminescent plankton glowing in the water along the shoreline.
experiences.location: Saracen Bay, Koh Rong Samloem, Sihanoukville

experiences.name: Khmer Cooking Class and Phsar Leu Market Tour
experiences.description: Join a hands-on Khmer cooking class led by a local chef, beginning with a guided tour of a bustling local market to select fresh ingredients like lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime. Learn to prepare traditional Cambodian dishes such as Fish Amok, Lok Lak, and Khmer red curry. Enjoy your creations for lunch and take home a recipe booklet.

experiences.name: Killing Fields and Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum
experiences.description: Visit the Choeung Ek Genocidal Center, known as the Killing Fields, and the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum (S-21 Prison) to understand Cambodia's tragic Khmer Rouge history. Audio guides provide deeply moving personal testimonies from survivors and historians. This sobering but essential cultural experience offers profound insight into modern Cambodian history and the resilience of its people.
experiences.location: Choeung Ek and Toul Tom Poung district, Phnom Penh
